key_insight: SYNRARE is a GUI built on Synthea that helps generate synthetic EHRs for rare-disease patients with controllable differences from common-disease patients for ML benchmarking.
clinical_relevance: It may help researchers test rare-disease detection models without using real patient records, reducing privacy and legal barriers.
method: Wraps the Synthea framework in an easier-to-use graphical interface.
Lets users modify synthetic patient generation to create rare-disease-like subsets.
Supports benchmarking ML algorithms across controlled synthetic scenarios.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports a tool demonstration for controlled synthetic EHR generation, but does not provide quantitative evaluation results or benchmark performance data.
watch_item: Synthetic EHRs can support benchmarking, but they may not fully capture the complexity and bias patterns of real-world rare-disease data.
paper_title: SYNRARE: Synthetic Rare Disease EHR Generation for ML Benchmarking
